releases.notes:
- Added support for 1.21.11
- Add the Remove ResourcePack Loading Screen feature
-------
- 添加 1.21.11 支持
- 添加移除资源包加载界面功能

- Fixed errors caused by certain visual block states
-------
- 修复某些视觉方块状态导致的错误

- Strictly check block registration to accommodate server-side plugin that relax restrictions, allowing the number of blocks registered on the client to be no less than on the server.
- Fix the issue of blocks missing tags.
------
- 注册方块时严格检查，以配合服务端插件放宽限制允许客户端注册的方块数量不小于服务端
- 修复方块没有标签的问题

## Bug Fix
- Fixed in versions 1.20~1.21.3, items could not be picked from custom blocks within the server
------
## 错误修复
- 修复 1.20~1.21.3 无法在服务器内对着自定义方块选取物品

## Refactor
- Compatible with the latest CraftEngine plugins
- Resolved certain visual issues when enabling custom blocks within the server
------
## 重构
- 兼容最新 CraftEngine 插件
- 解决启用服务器内自定义方块的一些视觉问题
